MODE 2: CMPLX (Complex Numbers)

Rectangular (a+bi) and polar (r∠θ) arithmetic on complex numbers.

keys
MODE→2

In CMPLX, the imaginary unit i is the ENG key unshifted. Use this mode for AC circuit phasors, polynomial roots with imaginaries, and polar conversions. SHIFT EXE (Re⇔Im) toggles the real and imaginary parts of a result.

formula
(a+bi)+(c+di)
=(a+c)+(b+d)i

Example: add 3+2i and 1−4i

  1. MODE → 2
  2. 3 + 2i (i is ENG)
  3. + 1 − 4i EXE
  4. 4 − 2i
note

Polar vs rectangular presentation depends on calculator settings and conversion functions (Pol/Rec). Confirm angle unit before interpreting θ.
